answer_1.quote: NLG is an umbrella term used for a set of tasks where the objective is to generate a text as the output. In addition to auto regressive text generation, NLG covers tasks such as text summarization, text simplification, and graph to text generation.

answer_2.quote: Test BLEU and ROUGE (ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2) scores were used as the automatic evaluation metrics, as they are still very commonly used.

answer_4.quote: We carried out a human evaluation to validate the quality of the generated questions and the time taken by a tutor to correct a generated MWP.
answer_4.guideline: They were asked to record the time taken to correct each question. Then they were given the list of errors we identified in Table , and were asked to mark the type of errors they identified.
